name: Takayama Maki
source:
One of the original participants.

She is a reporter for a major weekly magazine. She is most famous for her gossip articles. Although usually laidback and kind, she's also shown to be somewhat sly.

[Edited from [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Maki_Takayama]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
